mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.id

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY p.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.code = #{roleCode} AND r.status = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted = 0
